title: Where the World Is Going: Demography, Prosperity and Economic Resilience
summary: Demography, health, trade and macroeconomic balance reveal national capacity that a GDP ranking cannot show on its own.
key_takeaway: Future opportunity depends on converting human potential into durable resilience; the strongest evidence comes from combinations of indicators, not one champion metric.

inline_figures.caption: Global child-mortality counts fall dramatically across the long run, with improvements visible across age groups.
Recent export paths highlight fast-growing economies that receive less attention than the largest global traders.
